"I need a ride because I accidentally telepathically communicated with a raccoon, and he's bringing his friends to follow me home."

"My apartment moved while I was out. I'm sure of it."

## Harmless Party Decisions Gone Awry

**The Dance Floor Philosopher**: James was having such a good time that he spent three hours explaining his "revolutionary" theory about breakfast cereals to anyone who would listen. His friends finally rescued the captive audience when James started drawing milk-to-cereal ratio diagrams on napkins.

**The Fashion Revolutionary**: Emma decided her outfit needed "upgrading" and fashioned a cape out of the decorative tablecloth. The host was surprisingly understanding, especially after Emma's friends helped replace it the next day with one that didn't have nacho cheese artwork.

After three strawberry daiquiris, Izzy developed what her friends call "The Invincible Izzy Syndrome." Suddenly convinced she had superhuman abilities, Izzy approached the karaoke stage with the confidence of a Grammy winner.
